# access.AccessContext

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Effective permissions and regional settings of the caller at a node (GET /v1/me/context).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.AccessContext` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `organization` | yes | `none` | The organization. |  |
| `permissions` | yes | `none` | Effective permissions of the caller at the node, sorted. |  |
| `project` | no | `personal` | The project, when the node is a project or unit. |  |
| `regional` | yes | `none` | Locale, time zones and currency resolved for the caller at the node. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization (tenant) of the node. |  |
| `unit` | no | `none` | The unit, when the node is a unit. |  |
